original.target_description: Experiment 3 File B recall, trial type (save/no-save) by File A word-count condition (eight/two words) mixed-design ANOVA interaction.

n.sample_role: Participants across both mutually exclusive File A word-count conditions in the mixed-design File B recall ANOVA; trial type repeated within participant.
n.exclusions: No Experiment 3 participant exclusions reported. Two initial familiarization trials followed by six experimental trials (three save, three no-save); trial counts are not participant N.
